name: How can I prevent future bathtub drain clogs?

mainEntity.name: How can I prevent future bathtub drain clogs?

acceptedAnswer.text: To prevent future bathtub drain clogs, regularly use a drain screen or hair catcher to prevent hair and debris from entering the drain. Avoid pouring grease or harsh chemicals down the drain. Periodically flush the drain with hot water and a mixture of baking soda and vinegar (not commercial drain cleaners) to help break down buildup. Regular maintenance and being mindful of what goes down the drain can significantly reduce clog frequency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prevent clogs by using hair catchers, avoiding grease/chemicals, and regularly flushing with hot water and baking soda/vinegar.
